entities.name: ArgJ query protein
observations: 422-aa query sequence is a strong ArgJ homolog: up to 47.1% identity across 92.4% query coverage (UniProt P62061; query-protein tool result).

ArgJ family enzyme is annotated to catalyze N-acetylglutamate formation from glutamate and acetyl-CoA, and transacetylation of N2-acetylornithine with glutamate to form ornithine and N-acetylglutamate; query assignment is homology-based.
ArgJ Pfam family PF01960.24 match spans residues 35–419 (i-Evalue 1.3e-128).
Closest reference annotations describe cytoplasmic localization and an alpha2-beta2 heterotetramer; neither trait is directly experimentally verified for this query sequence.

entities.name: L-arginine biosynthesis
observations: ArgJ homologs are annotated in the cyclic L-arginine biosynthesis pathway, including production of ornithine and N-acetylglutamate; pathway assignment for this query is inferred from homology.

entities.name: ArgJ ornithine transacetylation
observations: Candidate reaction: N2-acetyl-L-ornithine + L-glutamate = N-acetyl-L-glutamate + L-ornithine (Rhea RHEA:15349); associated with close ArgJ homolog annotations and inferred for query.

entities.name: ArgJ N-acetylglutamate synthesis
observations: Candidate reaction: L-glutamate + acetyl-CoA = N-acetyl-L-glutamate + CoA + H+ (Rhea RHEA:24292); associated with close ArgJ homolog annotations and inferred for query.
